history.summary: Shri Apteshwar Siddhivinayak Devasthan is a small neighbourhood Ganapati temple in Electricity Colony, Santa Inez, Panaji, Goa. The name 'Apteshwar' associates it with Shiva in the temple's title while the presiding deity is Siddhivinayak (Ganesha); it also appears in Goa temple lists as the 'Panjim Apteshwar Sidhivinayak temple'. No published history or founding date was found for this shrine - its antiquity and origin story are UNVERIFIED, and it appears to be a modest local devotional site rather than a historic temple. town_description: Panaji (Panjim) is the capital city of Goa, set on the southern bank of the Mandovi River estuary in North Goa district. It became the Portuguese capital of Goa in 1843 and retains a colonial character in its Latin Quarter of Fontainhas, while Altinho Hill hosts the archbishop's palace and state government buildings. It is the state's administrative and cultural centre and the main gateway for North Goa tourism.
